# Agent Store

> An agent you can trust with money: a shopping agent with quotes-before-orders, idempotent payments and exactly-once price alerts, on an engine that also delivers cited RAG customer service. Simulated commerce — no real charges.

Chat entry: https://benluo.art/store/

## API
- [Health](https://benluo.art/health): liveness of the deployed engine
- [Repository](https://github.com/Bensonluo/rag_chatbot): full REST/MCP surface, one-command full-stack demo, evaluation baselines (API docs render at `/docs` on any local run)

## MCP

The store facts layer speaks Model Context Protocol (Streamable HTTP) — the same
authoritative catalog, cart, quote, order and sandbox-payment tools as REST,
with elicitation-gated writes and structurally derived idempotency keys; every
tool declares spec annotations (readOnlyHint / idempotentHint / destructiveHint)
so hosts can risk-classify calls without reading docstrings. Run it
locally with `python -m app.commerce_provider.mcp_server`; a runnable client is
`examples/mcp_shopping_client.py` in the repository.

## Guarantees

- Every write carries a `request_key`; retries and reconnects never double-charge
- Orders and payments are staged, then confirmed separately and explicitly
- Approval and price-watch cards are server-authoritative; the card wins over narration
- Price watches ask exactly once per trigger and never order on your behalf

Simulated catalog (deterministic virtual store), simulated payments.
